title: Mindrail Decision record, schema version 1
description: A Decision answers "why did we choose this path?" (spec §53). Records are immutable: a newer Decision supersedes an older one instead of overwriting it.

schema_version.description: Reader compatibility window key (spec §95). 0.1 writes 1 and reads [1].

id.description: Stable repository-unique identity; the file name must agree with it.

status.description: A superseded Decision stays in the repository so lineage survives (spec §93).

created_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp (tech-stack §42). The two keywords divide one rule and do not restate each other: "format" owns calendar validity, which a regular expression cannot decide (it knows how long February is); "pattern" owns the spelling, which "format" is deliberately permissive about. RFC 3339 admits a lowercase "t" and "z", a leap second, and any offset, and none of those is a timestamp this project writes or can read back as the same instant — see decision D-49.

context.description: The situation that forced a choice.

decision.description: The choice itself, stated in one or more sentences.

consequences.description: What the choice costs or forecloses.

supersedes.description: Identities of the Decisions this record replaces (spec §93).

scope.description: Where the record applies (spec §54 scope levels).

target.description: Repository-relative, forward-slash path or symbol reference (tech-stack §74). Absent for PROJECT scope.
